body: Maintainer refresh: merged main into this branch. The only conflict was `crates/post/src/post/js.rs`, the post prelude, where both sides edited one line: main added `var postOptions = {};` (the post-options object from #224 and #211), and this PR added `units: "mm"` to the `machine` object. Both are kept. RECOMMENDED.md matches main. Re-tested on the merged tree: camcraft-post (post_engine 31, comp 6), and app conformance 6, posting 17, golden_cl 23 and lathe_post_g76 5, all green.
Correction to the review above: please disregard its note 3 (the sentence about 'the reversal of G64 P0.025'), which is garbled and asks for nothing. The verdict stands: ready to merge.
